name: FSUbers 12.0 2026

venue.name: Student Services Building, Florida State University

venue.details: 2nd Floor, enter door facing the red brick road and walk up the stairwell straight inside

information:
Due to available space, each competitor can only bring **one guest** into the competition area. There are many areas to explore around campus to explore for other guests. Please do not bring a guest unless you **noted so in your registration**. Let us know of any **concerns or special circumstances** and we may be able to accommodate them.

Please review the **[Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FSUbers1202026#74309-competitor-information)** tab before the competition.
Please review the **[Florida/Southeast Cubing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FSUbers1202026#74308-southeast-cubing-inc-and-florida-cubing)** tab for information on how to keep up with future competitions that are announced.
Please review **all other** tabs for more information on the competition.

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TurnBacktheClockMiami2026#76129-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
